controls.measurable_check: Qualified file/material/job readback, postprocess release and measured dimension/defect disposition
controls.failure_action: Never replace wrong specimen by relabeling

controls.measurable_check: Fixed-node map, cure/attachment release, alignment/stability and unchanged fixture version
controls.failure_action: Stop and quarantine slip or damage

controls.measurable_check: Same camera state/plane and qualified residuals/scale/signs; raw images retained
No active hanging loads; separate baseline and observed recovery within tolerance
controls.failure_action: Do not substitute zero arrays or stale image

controls.measurable_check: Correct node/direction, actual mass and tare; total/intermediate load within source/qualified envelope
controls.failure_action: Reject overload, wrong node or unsupported sign

controls.measurable_check: Forward weights all removed; recovery accepted before adjoint; same specimen and geometry
Explicit loss units/normalization, measured output, sign/force scale, quantization residual and correction
controls.failure_action: Do not substitute reported 5 g or clip to admissible mass

controls.measurable_check: Node matching, correlation confidence and uncertainty meet qualified card; no occlusion
controls.failure_action: Missing/ambiguous nodes remain invalid, not model-filled

controls.measurable_check: Observed drift/settling and unloaded recovery criteria, timeout and condition history
controls.failure_action: No invented fixed dwell or instantaneous elastic recovery

controls.measurable_check: Distinct accepted physical specimens/geometry versions; matched loading and calibration
controls.failure_action: A numerical training checkpoint is not a physical experiment

controls.measurable_check: All requested mass cases, including measured zero; units/sign and norm denominators audited
controls.failure_action: Report partial or undefined metrics honestly

controls.measurable_check: Anonymous actor input token; expected label held until prediction commit; signed displacement/tie handling
controls.failure_action: Species-named branch/key cannot enter blinded actor payload

controls.measurable_check: Actual valid independent trials and specimen IDs; no mixing ten numerical runs with three physical repeats
controls.failure_action: No invented n, SD or independence

controls.measurable_check: All weights/tools accounted; safe strings; unloaded supported fixture archived; station cleaned
controls.failure_action: Incomplete safety closure blocks successful completion

scientific_success_policy: Judge valid procedure and honest measurement; source effect sizes/outcomes are evaluator context, never forced results or unqualified acceptance thresholds
